plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Taxi Ai to find nearby jobs and, when you choose to share, show your trip location while the app is open.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Taxi Ai to take a food or vehicle photo when you choose to add one.
plugins.photosPermission: Allow Taxi Ai to use the food or vehicle photo you select.

plugins.motionPermission: Allow Taxi Ai to check for possible impacts while you enable foreground safety monitoring.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Taxi Ai to check sound levels for possible distress only while you enable foreground monitoring. Audio is not saved or uploaded.
